title: Sample rubric: project report
opening: Hello {name}, here is my feedback on your project report.
closing: Come and see me if you want to talk any of this through.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.comment: State the question your report answers in one sentence near the start.

levels.label: Developing
levels.comment: Your question is there, but it is broad; narrow it so one report can answer it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.comment: Your question is clear and focused enough to answer in the space you had.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.comment: Your question is sharp and well chosen, and every section serves it.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.comment: Support your claims with sources, and say where each one comes from.

levels.label: Developing
levels.comment: You use some sources; check that each claim you rely on has one.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.comment: Your claims are supported by suitable sources, cited consistently.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.comment: You weigh your sources against each other and explain why each can be trusted.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.comment: Group related points into sections so the reader can follow your argument.

levels.label: Developing
levels.comment: The sections are there; add sentences that link one to the next.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.comment: The report is well organised and easy to follow.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.comment: The structure carries the argument: each section builds on the one before.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.comment: Read your report aloud to find sentences that are hard to follow.

levels.label: Developing
levels.comment: Most sentences are clear; proofread for spelling and punctuation.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.comment: Your writing is clear and mostly free of errors.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.comment: Your writing is precise and easy to read throughout.
